title: RPO and RTO: turning a promise into a number somebody signed

videos.script: Ask how much data the business can lose, and how long it can be down. The first answer is always the same. None, and none. {{none}} That answer is not a requirement. It is what people say before they see the price. {{price}} This lesson replaces it with two numbers, both measured in time. How far back you go, and how long you are gone. {{rpo-rto}} You measure the first on your own server, with one query: how much it would lose if its disk died right now. {{rpo}} Then you measure the second, by replaying two gigabytes of log and timing it. {{replay}} Last, you write both numbers down, beside the cost of doing better, and a name beside each. {{signed}} Because the time to agree on them is before the incident, not during it.
